Refactor #1: Template Method on Animal.act() w/ hooks (seekFood/actsAtNight/onFoodFound/breeding accessors). #2: Registry-based factories (Map of type→constructor lambda in base AnimalFactory + PlantFactory, kills if/else dispatch; RNG order preserved). #3: Template Method on Plant.act() (Grass/Sage/Sedge had identical act; hooks getMaxAge/getMultiplyProbability, OPTIMAL_BREEDING_FACTOR centralized). #4: Factory Method replaces reflection — abstract reproduce() hook on Animal+Plant, each species returns new Self(false,...); killed java.lang.reflect, ANIMAL_CONSTRUCTOR_SIGNATURE, Plant.getConstructor. #5: Form Template Method on food search — lifted shared adjacent-iteration loop into Animal.findFood() + abstract eatAt(Location); Carnivore/Herbivore implement eatAt; collapsed seekFood wrappers. Fingerprints unchanged. #6: Extract Superclass Organism (implements Actor) — lifted alive/field/location/age + isAlive/incrementAge/setDead/setLocation/getLocation/getField from Animal+Plant; grid ops become abstract hooks placeInField/clearFromField. Plant.setLocation dead-branch field.clear→clearPlant (never executed). Fingerprints unchanged. Substantive structural work now exhausted (6 refactors); remaining ideas risk behavior change or are non-harness-covered (GUI/PopulationGenerator).

content.text:
Done. Refactoring #2 converts four more `static final class` types in `ObservableInternalHelper.java` to `record`:

- **`ReplaySupplier`** — the lone `static final class` in a group of four replay supplier types; the other three (`BufferedReplaySupplier`, `BufferedTimedReplaySupplier`, `TimedReplayCallable`) were already records.
- **`FlatMapWithCombinerInner`**, **`FlatMapWithCombinerOuter`**, **`FlatMapIntoIterable`** — single-responsibility adapter classes that hold only immutable fields, consistent with all other adapters in the file.

Result: 30 lines removed, same behaviour, compiles clean.
